title: attack-set.v1
description: S055 §5.5 — output of one attacking team in the `crossfire` round. Each attacker sees ONLY other teams' outputs. `attacks` has minItems:1 per target — a 'looks good / all good' verdict is SCHEMA-INVALID (the attacker is punting). Owner: adversarial-team-brainstorm. The tournament script validates target coverage and does a deterministic single retry on a sycophantic miss.

flaws.description: >=1 flaw per target — 'looks good' is not admissible.
